name: ruleset
wording: the rules of one standard convention as the convention itself states them, under its own name, never a variant of it; offered together at install, taken whole or rule by rule; a project wanting a variant states it in its own files
reason: Moved from canon: canon's subject was an inventory of what cratylus ships, which is the product itself, not a concept; a rule and a ruleset are things an agent works by, in the same language as skill, so they belong to agents.
